items.text: It’s impossible to overstate the importance of safety in intralogistics. In addition to substantial costs, accidents and damage can have other serious consequences. Accidents involving people in particular often lead to personal harm and lengthy recovery processes. This can also impact productivity and the smooth running of operations, which can have extremely negative knock-on effects for the company’s competitiveness.

This is where Linde Material Handling comes in. With our wide range of innovative safety solutions, we offer the ideal technology for any application, providing optimal protection for your drivers and employees as well as the transported goods, racking, and other machinery. From the initial safety analysis to sophisticated light solutions and intelligent assistance systems through to fleet management, we provide you with comprehensive support to help you implement safe and efficient intralogistics processes.

With our “Vision Zero” initiative, we at Linde Material Handling have set ourselves the ambitious goal of reducing the number of accidents at our customers’ premises to zero. This is based on our holistic approach to safety, which aims to maximize operational safety in intralogistics and eliminate accidents altogether. To help make this vision a reality, we are developing innovative safety features for Linde trucks as well as offering comprehensive .

It’s becoming increasingly challenging to keep warehouses safe. Each year, thousands of accidents involving industrial trucks are reported, many of which occur when trucks are reversing. In this episode of the Logistics Business Conversations podcast, experts Elke Karnarski and Fabian Zimmermann from Linde Material Handling discuss the biggest safety risks in warehouses and intralogistics and what can be done to avoid them.

Our intelligent safety technologies and networked systems ensure optimal protection for people and machines during operation. From collision avoidance and fleet management through to automated processes, we offer sophisticated solutions to increase safety and efficiency.

In modern intralogistics systems people and industrial trucks often work side by side, in some cases under enormous time pressure. The risk of accidents is particularly high in areas where pedestrians and trucks frequently come into contact. Blind spots, areas with poor visibility, and high noise levels further increase the risk of accidents. Our Linde Safety Guard assistance system is a reliable solution to help increase the safety of drivers and pedestrians in the immediate vicinity of the truck. Warning zones are created around people, trucks, and infrastructure elements. In the event of danger, visual and acoustic warnings are emitted to warn those nearby. The warning zones can be individually adjusted.

Our myLinde fleet management solution is packed with features that have been specially developed for safety in day-to-day warehouse operations. It can be used to set a speed limit for trucks, for example. myLinde also offers functions such as monitored access control, automatic transmission of error codes, and analysis of usage data.

Transport processes using automated guided vehicles (AGVs) can be another building block to help improve safety in internal material flows. Modern sensors for environment sensing, innovative navigation technologies, and integrated safety functions help to significantly reduce the risk of accidents. A high degree of process reliability is also ensured thanks to standardized processes.
We will be happy to advise you on the ideal safety solution for your fleet.

Good visibility for the driver and other people nearby are essential requirements for a safe warehouse. That’s why we fit our industrial trucks with state-of-the-art lighting and warning lights that are visible from distance.

Our intelligent driver assistance systems actively help the driver to avoid accidents and maneuver safely. Whether counterbalanced forklift trucks, warehouse trucks, reach trucks, or very narrow aisle trucks, Linde Material Handling offers a wide range of solutions that make drivers’ day-to-day work easier and increase safety in the warehouse.

Explosive environments are a common occurrence in many industries, such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food, logistics, and recycling. In environments like this, gases, vapors, and dust can combine to create hazardous conditions. With this in mind, it is essential that industrial trucks used in these areas have the highest possible explosion protection.

Linde Material Handling GmbH provides that guarantee an adequate level of safety without compromising on efficiency and ergonomics. The portfolio includes explosion-proof versions of various counterbalanced forklift trucks, reach trucks, pallet stackers, and pallet trucks, as well as a range of safety systems with an explosion-proof design that comply with EU standard EN 1755 and the ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU. This enables Linde to ensure safe and efficient material flows, even under challenging, explosion-proof conditions.

Heineken Switzerland has a challenging working environment that includes heavy forklifts, tight turnarounds, large handling volumes, and jobs where people and machines are constantly working side by side. To make sure it has everything covered in terms of safety, the company has invested continuously in safety innovations right from the start. The brewery was one of the first companies to introduce the Linde Safety Guard back in 2017—and has adapted the modular solution to meet its specific needs several times since.

It’s what you add that makes the difference— and for industry specialist CEMEX Admixtures that applies to their intralogistics as well as their construction admixtures. The fleet of forklifts at the company’s site in Salzkotten, Germany has a new addition—the AI-based Linde System Reverse Assist Camera, which has significantly improved safety levels in reversing maneuvers.

At its French plant in Les Pennes-Mirabeau, Coca-Cola European Partners France has raised its existing safety standards to a whole new level with the Linde Safety Guard assistance system by Linde Material Handling.

The products of a well-known gardening tool manufacturer are stored up to 13 meters high at the Seifert Logistics Group in the north of Ulm, Germany. Yet despite this considerable height, the reach trucks not only load and unload the shelves extremely quickly, but also extremely safely. This is mainly thanks to Linde’s Dynamic Mast Control (DMC) assistance system.
Safety Scrutinized from an Objective Perspective

When it comes to potential risks in intralogistic processes, an external perspective can be worth its weight in gold, and this proved to be the case at CTL Celltechnik Lodenau in the German region of Saxony. With the help of the Linde Safety Scan, CTL was able to significantly reduce the risk of accidents in its internal goods handling.

The numbers are impressive: Over a surface area of 126 football fields in Wismar, Egger processes in the region of million cubic meters of wood each year for HDF, MDF and OSB boards as well as laminate flooring. Since February, the wood-based materials specialist has relied on forklift trucks with Linde Safety Pilot for its logistics needs.

Safety is of the utmost importance for Smurfit Kappa LithoPac, who are based in Nybro. The high level of safety that the company has achieved from day one is guaranteed by the Linde Safety Guard assistance system.
Optimization is a question of chemistry

Simple does not always mean trivial: proof of this is the automation project of Linde Material Handling for BASF Italia. In order to optimize efficiency and safety, a flexible, secure and fast-to-implement solution for Logistics 4.0 was integrated on the basis of an automated guided vehicle (AGV).
Schenker takes full control of its forklift truck fleet
DB Schenker has full control of its forklift truck fleet thanks to Linde’s innovative fleet management system Linde connect.
Automotive supplier SMP controls its vehicle fleet with Linde connect
The Linde connect fleet management system makes a decisive contribution to order and safety in the warehouse. Linde Material Handling has equipped the entire SMP fleet with this intelligent solution.
